evaluation_binding: evaluation_t reads the exact parameter ResultHandle theta_t current after optimizer step t
future_after_cut: all occurrences with optimizer_step greater than prediction_cut_step
optimizer_step_t: the concrete optimizer occurrence that reads theta_t and forms theta_t_plus_1
parameter_generated_origin: theta_t_plus_1 is the GeneratedOrigin read by the next forward occurrence
time_authority: occurrence identity, exact reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, program_order and parameter-version identity
